rationale: The short thesis remains partially intact: price at $16.35 is still below session VWAP ($16.53) and near the bottom of the day's range (17.6%), with the risk-off tape (SPY -0.43%, VIXY +0.62%) favoring continuation in this high-beta name. The original invalidation at $16.42 has not been touched and risk is well-defined just 0.4% away, so I see no reason to lock the small loss; however, the failure to make meaningful downside progress (MFE only 0.62%) and price reclaiming the 5m 9-EMA ($16.34) keeps conviction modest rather than high.
